gate_attempted.why_this_is_a_HARNESS_limitation_and_not: TWO harness facts, both measured on this box rather than inherited. (1) The gate reads a record schema this phase does not write: it expects a SINGULAR `target_test` and a top-level `exit_code` it can parse, and this phase has recorded a `target_tests` ARRAY since 31-35 because every RED here fails a SET of cases rather than one. With `target_test` empty the gate fail-closes to `invalid_record` before it ever reads a transcript. (2) Even with a conforming record the transcript is unreadable to it: the parser reads node:test's '# tests / # pass / # fail' TAP summary lines, and `npx vitest run --reporter=tap` emits none — MEASURED on this run's own transcript, `grep -c '^# tests'` = 0. TDD_MODE was false for this plan, so this gate is not the authorizing gate for GREEN here; it is recorded as attempted WITH ITS MEASURED VERDICT rather than silently skipped, and no verdict was fabricated.
